candidates.look: 4/5 - posts at 500 + round-head bolts read as riveted tender plate; continuous welding would oil-can (2/5)

candidates.move: Skin 6 mm → 8 ga (4.2 mm) steel (alternative to S1)

candidates.approv: Harder - poor fire barrier around two diesels and exhaust; galvanic isolation; not CWF's usual material

candidates.move: Deck PL10 → 6 mm tread plate on 7 full-width C6 cross-bearers (replaces PL10 + outriggers)
candidates.approv: Easy - equipment mounts land on rails and cross-bearers; spill floor stays steel and sealed

candidates.approv: AWAIT supplier data (mass, cooling air, open-frame rating); fuel from the shared tank

candidates.move: Smaller generator (≈25 kW) by cutting coach heat/cool load
candidates.approv: Not recommended - hot-humid case is already 4.7 kW short at 35 kW

candidates.move: Coal-effect cover 3 mm → 1.5 mm (16 ga) formed steel, textured coating
candidates.approv: Easy - steel stays fire-safe near the exhaust
candidates.look: 5/5 - same shape, black with gold edge trim

candidates.look: Loses the owner's look - not recommended

candidates.move: Lighter main rails / lightening holes in rails or drop boxes
candidates.approv: Not worth it - rails carry the 200 kN buff with the 286 mm offset moment + fatigue; holes in HSS add fatigue and corrosion details

candidates.move: Move tender equipment to the locomotive
candidates.approv: No gain at 2%: train mass is unchanged and the motors, not adhesion, are the limit. Only helps if it replaces dead ballast kg-for-kg

ballast_note: Each 1 t of loco ballast left out adds 0.40 kN; loco 15.8 t is well above the 11.9 t dry-2% adhesion minimum.
